label: Feature delivery
description: Acceptance criteria, focused implementation, tests, compatibility, and handoff.

assignments.lead: Implementation lead — translate acceptance criteria into tests, implement the smallest complete feature, run gates, and commit a focused change.
assignments.reviewer: Reviewer — inspect behavior, API compatibility, edge cases, and the lead diff independently. Do not edit production code.
assignments.verifier: Verifier — exercise acceptance criteria and negative paths independently. Limit edits to tests or fixtures and commit separately.

required_evidence: Automated tests for normal and edge behavior
Repository-defined test, lint, and format gates
